column5: The first __mod_init_func entry uses the first byte of the EAGL view singleton storage. The next word is the view pointer.
The second libstdc++ initializer in __mod_init_func is paired with the byte immediately after the 8-byte view globals.
The third __mod_init_func entry registers the next one-byte ios_base::Init object. All three destructors use the same imported libstdc++ destructor.
